title: docs(skills): a suite composes under manifest preserve; a flat composition of two apps under one package is refused

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`bootstrap.md`「多应用组合」一节改为:套件(一个 app 包加若干 module 包,各带一个应用)用 `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })` 组合,保留每个包自己的 id(`examples/app-multi-package` 就这么用);扁平组合(`'last'` 默认、`'first'`、索引)只留一个 manifest,一个 app/module 包 id 下落两个以上应用即被拒(`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`,422)。删掉「本仓没有应用用它」这句错话。`objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`「App Navigation」补同一条补救:套件用 `preserve` 组合,扁平组合会被拒。
- 为什么改:#32810(PR #32898)已让 `composeStacks` 拒绝扁平组合出「一个包 id 下多个应用」,技能文字没教 `preserve`,AI 照写扁平组合会白跑一轮被拒。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字,两个文件 +32/-24 行,外加 `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset;新增文字由同文件删除重复内容付账,两个文件都仍在 token 上限内,未抬任何上限;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md` 的 Multi-App Composition 一节;`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 第 139–147 行(App Navigation 第二段)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep -E "bootstrap|objectstack-ui/SKILL"`,预期 bootstrap.md 1340/1343、objectstack-ui SKILL.md 3809/3814,均不超限。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-platform/references/bootstrap.md`, § Multi-App Composition.** The `composeStacks()` paragraph said "No app in this repo uses it — read the schema before reaching for it" and named no strategy for a suite. It now says: a suite (an app package plus module packages, one app each) composes with `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`, which keeps each package's own id (`examples/app-multi-package`); a flat `manifest` (`'last'`, the default, `'first'` or an index) keeps one, so two or more apps under one `app` or `module` package id are refused (`STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION`, 422). Card Work items 1 and 2.
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`, § App Navigation** (fold 6846119916 row 1). The suite sentence now ends with the remedy: the suite composes with `composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' })`, which serves each app under its own package id; a flat composition puts them under one and is refused.
- **`.changeset/32977-skills-suite-composes-under-preserve.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.
- **`docs/adr/0019-app-as-consumer-unit.md` is not touched** (fold 6846119916 row 2). The folded row and #33135 name the same sentence of the 2026-11-12 "Enforced for modules" note ("Two shapes are not judged ... a flat `composeStacks` ... and a hand-built `packages[]` body"), so the ADR stays with #33135 as the order rules. #33135's Expected names only the hand-built body; the flat-composition half of that sentence is false too since PR #32898, so #33135's PR should rewrite the whole sentence (noted in the report for the seat).

### Paid in the same file (no ceiling moved)

- `bootstrap.md`: the title's "(moved verbatim from SKILL.md)" (no longer true once this section changes); "this is how real multi-app composition happens" and "equal the physical table name" (the second restates `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Object naming); "Use barrel exports to keep config clean:" and "A minimal but complete project from scratch:" (each restates its heading); "(traditional)" and "(key becomes name) ... for readability" in the Map Format comments (the sentence above the block says the key becomes the `name`); the `stack.zod.ts` file pointer (`references/_index.md` carries the schema pointers).
- `objectstack-ui/SKILL.md`: the `subforms` example's "relationshipField + columns are derived from the child object" comment (the paragraph under the list says the FK and columns are derived in every case); the `requiresObject` / `requiresService` note shortened to what it says ("hide an item whose optional system object or kernel service is missing"). The pinned lines named in the file's CEILINGS entry are untouched.

## Why

Read on `origin/main` 34c05229, `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`:

- `SINGLE_APP_PACKAGE_TYPES` = `app`, `module`. `SINGLE_APP_COMPOSE_REMEDY` is the text every single-app finding names: "compose the packages into one artifact with composeStacks(stacks, { manifest: 'preserve' }), which keeps each package's own id (a flat composition puts every app back under one)".
- `composeStacks` calls `collectComposedSingleAppErrors(stacks, composed, opts.manifest)` and throws `StackSingleAppViolationError` (`code = 'STACK_SINGLE_APP_VIOLATION'`, `status = 422` from `StackRefusalError`) with the header `composeStacks single-app validation failed (N issues):`. With no `packages[]` in the result, `flatSingleAppFinding` refuses when the composed manifest's type is in the set and the composed `apps` has more than one entry, naming each app with the input it came from.
- `examples/app-multi-package/objectstack.config.ts` line 68: `export default composeStacks([ordersStack, coreStack], { manifest: 'preserve' });`, so the old "No app in this repo uses it" was false.

## Acceptance notes

- `resolveArtifactCollections` (`@objectstack/runtime`, named in 6846119916 as the platform reader the remedy could name) is not taught: the ask is the `preserve` remedy, the file has no headroom, and an author composes with `composeStacks`, not with the runtime reader.
- No eval is added: the card asks for teaching text only.
- `origin/main` moved to b5f2f516 (#33292) after the branch was cut; it touches none of these files, so no merge.
